import json,urllib.request
TOK=open("/root/nocodb-token.txt").read().strip()
def get(p):
    r=urllib.request.Request("http://localhost:8080"+p,headers={"xc-token":TOK})
    return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=60).read().decode())
m=get("/api/v2/meta/tables/m58xsjo6at01ohl")
print("TABLE:",m["title"],"cols:",len(m["columns"]))
for c in m["columns"]:
    if c.get("system"): continue
    extra=""
    if c["uidt"]=="SingleSelect":
        try: extra="["+",".join(o["title"] for o in c["colOptions"]["options"])+"]"
        except Exception: extra=""
    print("%-28s %-14s %s"%(c["title"],c["uidt"],extra))
EOF
